data.sender_name: Agentur für Arbeit Musterlüne (Bundesagentur für Arbeit)

items.title: File Widerspruch against Sperrzeit decision
items.quote: Gegen diese Entscheidung ist innerhalb eines Monats nach ihrer Bekanntgabe Widerspruch möglich – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Agentur für Arbeit Musterlüne.
items.computation: The Widerspruch period is one month and starts to run on the day the decision is deemed 'bekanntgegeben' (notified). For a letter sent by ordinary mail from a German authority, § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X deems it delivered on the third day after posting (with weekend/holiday roll-forward), unless it was actually received later or earlier delivery is proven. However, this letter carries no document date/dispatch date at all, so neither the posting day nor the three-day delivery day can be established, and therefore the one-month period under § 84 SGG cannot be calculated. If a dispatch date were known, the month would run under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (ending on the same-numbered day of the following month, or the next business day in NRW if that day is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday). Without that anchor date, the due date cannot be fixed; the user must check the actual postmark/receipt date on their copy of the letter to compute it themselves (deliver Widerspruch no later than one month after the day they actually received or are deemed to have received this letter).

items.title: Sperrzeit (12-week suspension of ALG entitlement) period
items.quote: Es ist deshalb eine Sperrzeit von zwölf Wochen eingetreten (§ 159 Abs. 1 Satz 2 Nr. 1 SGB III).
items.computation: The Sperrzeit is tied to the self-initiated termination of employment effective 31.12.2026 ('Sie haben Ihr Beschäftigungsverhältnis ... selbst zum 31.12.2026 gekündigt'). Standard practice is that the Sperrzeit begins the day after the employment ends, i.e. 01.01.2027, and lasts 12 full weeks (84 days). Counting 01.01.2027 as day 1, the 12-week period ends on 25.03.2027. This is informational (the claimant need not act), derived indirectly since the letter itself does not state the start/end dates explicitly, so confidence is low.

warnings: The letter has no printed document date (no 'Datum' field), so the three-day delivery fiction under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X cannot be applied and the exact one-month Widerspruch deadline cannot be computed from the text alone — the user should check the postmark or the date on their own copy and count one month from the actual/deemed receipt date.

The 12-week Sperrzeit start and end dates (01.01.2027–25.03.2027) are inferred from the stated termination date (31.12.2026) and are not explicitly stated in the letter, so treat them as estimates only.
